Overlap currently uses <= which counts touching intervals as overlapping, but spec says touching end/start does not count. Also need same day: overlaps doesn't check day. Should also ensure same day. Additionally find_conflicts loops over all pairs both directions and includes duplicates; should only consider j > i to avoid duplicates. Also need to ensure no conflict across different days: currently doesn't check day, so sessions on different days may overlap but should not be considered.

Let's fix Session.overlaps to check same day and strict overlap ( < not <=). Overlap definition: intervals (start,end) exclusive? Should be start < other.end and other.start < self.end for true overlap, i.e., not touching. Also ensure days match.

Implement in models.py.

Also modify find_conflicts to iterate j from i+1 to end.
